objects.name: Analytic 2117
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to alarm threshold configuration files on a Linux-based alarm server by a User Identifier (UID) that is not the alarm management service. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL+PATH records: write to alarm threshold config file by uid not in authorized alarm admin User Identifiers (UIDs)
